notes:
Japan has a rich tradition of appreciating insects, including keeping them as pets and listening to their sounds.

Major insect groups:
- ⟦{甲虫|こうちゅう}→甲虫：04929_kouchuu⟧ (beetles) - ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧, ⟦クワガタ→クワガタ：05130_kuwagata⟧
- ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧ (butterflies)
- ⟦{蛾|が}→蛾：05011_ga⟧ (moths)
- ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧ (bees, wasps)
- ⟦{蟻|あり}→蟻：04291_ari⟧ (ants)
- ⟦{蝉|せみ}→蝉：09931_semi⟧ (cicadas)
- ⟦トンボ→トンボ：05204_tonbo⟧ (dragonflies)
- ⟦バッタ→バッタ：06515_batta⟧ (grasshoppers)

⟦{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}→昆虫採集：28686_konchuusaishuu⟧ (insect collecting) is a popular summer activity for children.
